In the game

Build your dino empire

Pick your dinosaur, then roam the island eating, growing and battling. Collect coins, unlock skins in the shop, finish tasks and climb the leaderboard. Invite friends and anyone with the link can join the same world.

Game mode

Dinosaur Hide & Seek

One dino seeks, the farm animals hide. Play against bots or real players on the farm map.

Join the rampage!

In the game

Start on your own island

Wake up in your home on the Starting Island, meet the villagers and get your first rod. Then take your boat out, fill your Fishdex, cook and farm, and play with friends online.

TRADE. BUILD. INVEST. CONNECT THE WORLD.

Run a shipping company in a living world economy. Start with two small ships, carry cargo between ten islands and grow into a global business.

Play now →
TRADEBuy cheap, sell dear across ten islands
BUILDFound your own factories
INVESTShares, bonds and takeovers
CONNECTShips, ports and supply chains
In the game

A world that runs on real cargo

Every ship on the map is a real shipment from one company to another. Take freight contracts, buy goods where they are cheap and sell them where they are scarce, and watch your own ships live as they sail. Storms and busy ports can slow everything down, so keep your fleet in good repair.

Look inside

Every company is a working business

Open any of 79 companies and see its factories, suppliers, staff and finances. Find the bottleneck that holds a factory back, and follow the chain to learn why a company is losing money. Then found a company of your own in any country.

Two ways to play

Normal mode or Pro mode

Normal mode keeps the focus on shipping, trading and building your own factories. Pro mode adds the full stock and bond market, central banks and company takeovers. A guided tutorial with our milk-carton mascot starts with every new game.

Your trade empire starts here!

Free to play in your browser.

Updates and announcements

Oct 5, 2026

Sour Milk Logistics is playable now

Our third game is out. Run a shipping company in a living world economy, right in your web browser.

Start with two small ships and carry cargo between ten islands. Trade goods between ports, look inside any of 79 companies to see how their factories really run, invest in them, and build factories of your own. Our milk-carton mascot guides you through the first steps.

Learn more Play now →
Oct 5, 2026

Ocean Bound update this week: Blossom Islands

A peaceful new region is coming to Ocean Bound this week. Set sail for the Blossom Islands and explore cherry blossom forests, lively villages, shrines and waterfalls.

The update adds new islands to explore, new fish species to catch, new locations, new resources to collect, and new quests with new characters to meet. You'll also find colorful reefs with rare species and mysterious caves hiding secrets. Stay tuned!

Play Ocean Bound →
Oct 5, 2026

Five new games are coming from Sour Milk Studios

We're working on five new worlds: Hearthfield, Kingdom & Haven, Aqua Haven, Cook & Serve and Sour Milk Logistics.

Hearthfield is a cozy farming life in a village full of stories. Kingdom & Haven lets you build, grow and defend your own kingdom. Aqua Haven is about building your dream aquarium world. In Cook & Serve you shop, cook and run a restaurant. Sour Milk Logistics puts a living global economy in your hands. All five are coming soon. Follow us on Instagram for the first looks.

See the games →
Sep 29, 2026

Dino Rampage and Ocean Bound are playable now

Both of our games now run in the web browser. Press Play and jump in, alone or with friends.

Dino Rampage lets you eat, grow and rampage across a prehistoric island. Ocean Bound takes you sailing and fishing across a bright ocean. Both games have online play, so anyone with the link can join.
